# OpenVR header provenance

`openvr.h` is the public Valve OpenVR SDK 2.15.6 header from commit
`0924064316de3effbcd1acf1e309182a2deb1c05`:

https://github.com/ValveSoftware/openvr/blob/0924064316de3effbcd1acf1e309182a2deb1c05/headers/openvr.h

SHA-256: `1e6ed57199896cc1f7c5484e50fa18955e97be15be690beb28d998c877ead7fd`

The accompanying BSD license is in `OpenVR-LICENSE.txt`. The prototype loads the
user's installed SteamVR runtime; no Valve runtime binaries are distributed here.
